newsitem.title: USA: Country Star Restaurants names Rubin CEO.
newsitem.headline: Country Star Restaurants names Rubin CEO.

text.p: Country Star Restaurants Inc said it named Dan Rubin as its new chief executive and president, effective immediately.
Rubin, an investor in the company, replaces Robert Schuster as chief executive and Peter Feinstein as president.
Both officers resigned their posts recently, although Schuster will remain on the company's board, according to Rubin.
The company owns and operates the Country Star American Music Grills.
Rubin said the company's board of directors now consists of himself, William Wei, Darren Rice, Robert Nardone and Schuster.
Rubin said Wei, Rice and Nardone were his nominees to the board.
